answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce hardware-rooted attestation inside secure enclaves. At the admission inlet, each node submits hardware proofs to an audit lantern and must echo random challenge nonces. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of provisioning physical, tamper-resistant processor chips per identity. However, this mechanism depends on centralized chip manufacturers and remains vulnerable to silicon side-channel exploits.
